scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) if [ -n "$VERCEL" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile --filter @workspace/admin --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/scripts --filter @workspace/website --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
